scripts.watch: concurrently "npm run tw" "npm run watch:st" "npm run server" "npm run watch:assets"
scripts.copy:assets: find app short.js -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.css' -o -name '*.html' \) -exec sh -c 'for f; do mkdir -p "/tmp/short/$(dirname "$f")" && cp "$f" "/tmp/short/$f"; done' sh {} +
scripts.watch:assets: npm run copy:assets && onchange 'app/**/*.js' 'app/**/*.css' 'app/**/*.html' 'short.js' -- sh -c 'f=$1; mkdir -p "/tmp/short/$(dirname "$f")" && cp "$f" "/tmp/short/$f"' -- {}
